subject: Marketplace renewal — evidence bundling & acceptance window coordination
messages:
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@omnihealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-11-01T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Marketplace renewal — evidence needs and acceptance window

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the call this morning. OmniHealth is ready to move forward on the renewal and the two private offers (AWS & GCP) we discussed, but procurement has a tight set of acceptance/evidence requirements we need to lock down before we execute. Can you confirm the following?

- A single zipped evidence bundle (SOC2 report, data retention matrix, network diagram, and relevant ATO notes) we can hand off to our InfoSec team.
- A proposed acceptance window(s) for staged activation (we prefer a 2-week window for initial verification, then a 30-day ramp to full capacity).
- Whether we can split invoicing across two POs (AWS private offer + GCP marketplace) but keep a single legal amendment and coordinated acceptance schedule.

If you can send a checklist and a target timeline today, procurement can try to align signatories and return the signed PO by end-of-week. Also looping in our channel partner, Paul Guerrero, who will handle the marketplace billing questions.

Attachments: none

Best,
Samantha Lee
Head of Procurement, OmniHealth
Samantha.Lee@omnihealth.com
+1-415-555-0172

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@omnihealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Paul Guerrero <paul.guerrero@cloud-resell.com>
Date: 2027-11-01T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace renewal — evidence needs and acceptance window

Samantha — thanks, good notes. Looping Marissa and Priyom to own the billing/PO choreography and evidence packaging. Quick responses to your bullets below and proposed next steps: 

- Evidence bundle: we can produce a single zip containing the SOC2 Type II (redacted where appropriate), our data retention matrix, network diagram, and a short ATO summary. I'll attach a checklist for InfoSec to confirm contents (see attached).
- Acceptance windows: we propose a two-stage acceptance plan: 
  * Stage 1 (validation): 10 business days for InfoSec and a light production smoke test (10% traffic).
  * Stage 2 (ramp): 30 calendar days from Stage 1 sign-off to reach full committed capacity.
- Split invoicing: yes, we can accept two POs but will issue a single consolidated amendment referencing both marketplace offers to keep legal tidy. Marissa will confirm proration and invoice cadence.

Next steps:
1) I will upload the evidence checklist and the acceptance runbook to the DocuSign package and share the link.
2) Marissa to confirm invoice timing and whether finance needs a staggered billing memo.
3) Priyom to confirm technical acceptance criteria for the 10% canary.

Attachments: evidence_requirements_checklist.xlsx

—
Kimberly Park
Director, Cloud Marketplace Partnerships
Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com
+1-650-555-0123

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-11-01T14:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace renewal — acceptance sequencing & billing notes (internal)

Marissa / Kimberly / Ben — internal notes on sequencing and what I need from RevOps/Finance: 

- We should treat AWS private offer as the lead PO for deployment timing; GCP can be activated on the same acceptance plan but invoiced separately. To avoid double-billing risk, the legal amendment will reference both POs and include a reconciliation clause.
- Acceptance runbook (attached) contains the canary checklist: KV cache warm, end-to-end latency check at target SLA, sample set of prompts for quality regression. For Stage 1 we limit traffic to test namespaces and a 10% token cap.
- Proration: if OmniHealth wants staggered invoicing across fiscal tranches, Marissa we need a short memo to Finance (one paragraph) outlining: PO numbers, invoice dates, and tranche amounts. Finance will need the signed amendment and the DocuSign envelope id to process.

I'll produce the acceptance_runbook.md and a short evidence bundle (redacted SOC2 excerpt + diagrams) by tomorrow morning.

Attachments: acceptance_runbook.md

Subject: Re: Marketplace renewal — evidence needs and acceptance window

Samantha — following up with the plan and the docs we discussed. Summary and ask: 

1) Evidence bundle: attached is the evidence bundle v2 (redacted SOC2 excerpt, retention matrix, network diagram) and the acceptance runbook. Please share with InfoSec.

2) Acceptance windows (final):
   - Stage 1 (validation): 10 business days for verification + smoke tests (10% traffic).
   - Stage 2 (ramp): 30 calendar days to ramp to full committed capacity.

3) Split POs / invoicing: we will accept two POs (AWS / GCP). Marissa will issue a short billing memo confirming proration and invoice cadence once the amendment is signed. 

4) DocuSign: private offer & consolidated amendment are ready for signature: https://www.docusign.com/en/transactions/ABCDEF-123456 (DocuSign envelope id included). Please try to return signed docs by COB 2027-11-05 so we can schedule the Stage 1 verification the week of 2027-11-08.

Attachments: evidence_bundle_v2.zip; private_offer_OMH-2027-11-02.pdf

If you want, Paul can take the billing call with Marissa tomorrow to confirm PO numbering and invoice flow.

Thanks — talk soon,
